claims.statement: At the pinned snapshot, code referencing links matching suggestions to original public sources for attribution and provenance; this capability does not establish copyright permission, correctness or exhaustive match detection.

Matching-code details are conditional on the user or organization permitting suggestions matching public code, and are described for accepted inline suggestions and matching-code chat responses. Public-source attribution must not be treated as a distribution license.
The enhancements fragment describes a quick-reference aid for common chat commands and options; efficiency is an intended benefit, not measured performance or a required policy.

The accept/reject fragment describes command-palette acceptance or Tab acceptance and Esc rejection of all suggestions in its surrounding editor context; it is not an instruction to execute or accept unreviewed generated code.
The standalone acceptance fragment identifies Tab as its UI action; applicability depends on the embedding editor page and active focus rather than a universal shortcut.
The chat entry fragment points to the GitHub Copilot web endpoint with engagement parameters; a navigation link neither proves subscription eligibility nor authenticates access.

The metrics entry fragment first includes enterprise navigation and then directs the user to Insights. Its dependency distinguishes GHES profile-menu Enterprise settings from the other-version enterprise navigation branch; neither this fragment nor reading the dependency proves authorization, dashboard data availability or rendered product applicability.
